Alicia Herrero Liñana (born 29 December 1998) is a Spanish tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of 301 by the WTA and a best WTA doubles ranking of 123, both achieved on 3 November 2025. [ 1 ] Herrero Liñana has won one WTA 125 doubles title as well as one singles and 13 doubles titles on the ITF circuit. She attended Baylor University and played college tennis for the Baylor Bears. [ 2 ] Teaming with Valeriya Strakhova , she won her first WTA 125 doubles title at the 2025 Querétaro Open , defeating Marian Gómez Pezuela Cano and Varvara Lepchenko in the final.
